Score the lead 0-100 for fit. Return ONLY valid JSON matching the schema.

options.systemMessage: You are the Supervisor agent for the GoFunditNow Digital Scout pipeline. Given the run summary, decide and report: (1) whether wildcard vs core query frequency should shift based on hit rates, (2) which lead segments to re-search next run, (3) any anomalies (zero results, high invalid-email rate, warm-up failures). Output a short markdown ops report with concrete recommendations. Do not invent data.

parameters.content:
## API KEYS — one place, nothing hardcoded
All keys live in n8n Credentials (left sidebar > Overview > Credentials).
Open each credential and paste the key — nodes are already wired to them:

1. **Exa API — PASTE KEY** -> paste Exa key (used by all 3 search nodes)
2. **Unipile API — PASTE KEY** -> paste Unipile key + replace YOUR_DSN in the 2 Unipile node URLs
3. **OpenRouter — PASTE KEY** -> paste OpenRouter key (powers Fit + Supervisor agents, model openai/gpt-4o-mini — change to any OpenRouter model)
4. **Zoho CRM OAuth — CONNECT** -> paste Client ID + Secret from Zoho API Console (redirect URI shown in the credential), then click Connect. If your Zoho account is EU/IN, change zohoapis.com to zohoapis.eu / zohoapis.in in the Zoho node
5. **Email-Check.app API** -> DONE (live)

Then: run Manual Test Trigger end-to-end, check Executions, Publish.

## 1-3) Signal Sourcing
Three parallel Exa branches:
- GROWTH (core, domain-locked)
- RESCUE (core, domain-locked)
- WILD CARD (no domain filter, signal_type inferred)
All HTTP nodes continue on fail so one bad query never kills the run.

## 4) Normalize + Dedup
Single lead schema, per-run dedup + 30-day org cache (workflow static data). Growth/Rescue routing is tag-based (signal_type on every lead) — kept single-path to avoid duplicate execution waves.

## 5) Email Validation - email-check.app (LIVE)
GET api.email-check.app/v1-get-email-details, credential attached.
Valid = validFormat true AND isDisposable false.
Note: validSmtp is unreliable (false even for real Gmail) so it only feeds the soft score, not the gate.
Invalid + missing still flow to Fit + CRM ('Research Needed'), never get DMs.

## 6) Digital Warm-up (Unipile)
Find profile then queue: visit, follow, soft interaction. Failures tagged, never block. Add Wait nodes (30-120s random) between actions if you enable DMs.

## 7-8) Fit Agent + Zoho CRM
OpenRouter model powers both agents. Structured JSON: fit_score, recommended_play, talk_track, risk_flags.
Zoho upsert on Email; briefing + tags land in Description. Lead_Source = GoFunditNow Scout.
Optional: create Zoho custom fields (Fit_Score, Signal_Type, Campaign) and add them to the JSON body for filterable views.

## 9) Supervisor
Reviews run summary: wildcard vs core hit rate, anomalies, re-search recommendations. Extend with Exa/CRM/Unipile tool nodes for full autonomy; add a Slack node after Run Summary for ops alerts.

## PHASE 1 - Prioritized LinkedIn Outreach (DRY-RUN)
Inserted after **Attach Fit Results** -> merges back into **Zoho CRM: Upsert Lead**.
**Flow:** Confidence Gate -> Eligibility Filter (fit_score>=75 & match_ok & no risk_flags) -> Read Counter -> Budget Check (20/wk) -> Switch on network_distance.
DISTANCE_1 -> Send Message [DISABLED] -> status Messaged.  Other -> Condense Note -> Send Invitation [DISABLED] -> status Pending.

### SEND NODES ARE DISABLED (dry-run). Nothing goes to LinkedIn until you enable them.

### TODO before go-live:
- [ ] PROFILE MATCH: fix search input (don't feed company/headline as person name); pick people vs companies category; build clean keyword.
- [ ] PROFILE MATCH: replace naive check in 'P1: Confidence Gate' with real name/company/headline corroboration + tie-breaker for multiple results.
- [ ] Point 'P1: Read/Write Invite Counter' at your Google Sheet (cols: week_iso, invites_used) + connect Google credential.
- [ ] Set account_id + attach Unipile Header Auth credential on both send nodes.
- [ ] Verify LIVE: LinkedIn weekly invite limit (set budget) and invite-note char cap (set NOTE_CAP).
- [ ] Enable Branch A (message) first, then Branch B (invite) + Write Counter, after reviewing dry-run.
